violations.text: An open employees' beverage container was observed stored in a food preparation area (fryer station and sushi bar). Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. Staff informed to place fitted covers on cups. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (cooked chicken) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. The piece of chicken was discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

A dish scrubby was observed in the hand-washing sink in the fryer area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the server station. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Inspector observed raw eggs stored over lobster. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Inspector primed machine; dishwasher dispensed at less than 25 ppm. PIC to call for service. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (bowl) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Bowl was brought to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Cooked shrimp and bean sprouts were observed held at 46 degrees Fahrenheit above the fill line in the fryer area prep unit; recently cut fish was observed held at 46 degrees in the sushi display case. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All items were placed in alternate refrigeration to rapidly chill. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Working containers of spices, oils, rice, and flours are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025
Cases of water and Red Bull were observed stored on the floor in the bar area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Multiple containers of food were observed stored in direct contact with the foods below in the cookline prep units. PIC informed staff to cease practice. The beverage hose at the bar was observed in direct contact with beverage ice. Staff informed to place a barrier between the beverage hose and the ice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Wet wiping cloths are not stored in a chemical sanitizer between uses at the bar. Wet wiping cloths must be stored in a chemical sanitizer at the appropriate concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm) at the vegetable prep station. The required concentration for chlorine sanitizer is 50-100 ppm. Staff disposed of sanitizer and refilled sani bucket to proper concentration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of chicken. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Bowl was removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Doors to cook line prep units and the dessert low boy were in poor repair, observed misaligned or falling off hinges. Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine in the kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Working containers of dry spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Staff labeled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Dish scrubbies were observed in the hand-washing sinks in the fryer station and the server area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Scrubbies were removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Recently prepared chicken and shrimp were observed held at 46-54 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Recently cut tofu was observed held at 48 degrees in the prep unit. Shrimp was observed held at 45 degrees above the fill line in the fryer station prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were brought to the walk-in to rapidly chill; shrimp was placed in low-boy. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025
TPHC logs for sushi rice were lacking time and amount of discard and/or last rice used. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed cooked sauce placed in plastic containers greater than four inches deep. Staff were instructed to place in shallow pans to cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Working containers of spices and sauces at the cookline are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Staff labeled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025
Containers of various foods were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in and kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025
Ice scoops at the bar and server station were observed with handles stored in contact with the ice. Ice scoops were relocated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025
A knife was observed stored in a container of tofu and water. Knife was removed and brought to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Bar utensils are displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025
Single-use containers (soup base containers, sauce buckets) are being re-used to store other food items. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -ice machine -deli slicer -tape on bar beverage rack. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025
The cola refrigerator in the kitchen was not in good repair, observed held with tape. The door to the dessert low boy was misaligned. New Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2024
The support column in the kitchen was in poor repair, observed with peeling paint. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 11/15/2024
The public restrooms are lacking proper signage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Noodles was observed held at 54 degrees in the prep units. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff placed noodles in the reach-in portion of the prep unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/15/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of manager, recently cooked chicken was placed hot in the prep unit. Chicken was brought to walk-in to rapidly chill. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
A container of ingredients was observed in direct contact with the food below it. PIC removed. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

The scoops for dry ingredients were stored on an unclean surface (top of the containers) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. PIC brought scoops to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/15/2024

The cola refrigerator and rice hot hold units located in the kitchen are not in good repair, observed held with tape. The door to the dessert low-boy were observed mis-aligned. New Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer has an accumulation of food residue and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/15/2024
The support column in the kitchen area is in poor repair, observed with peeling paint. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
The hand-washing sink in the bar was blocked by to-go containers and chop sticks. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the sushi, bar, and hostess stations. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC obtained soap for sushi area during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024
Handwashing signage was lacking in the public restroom. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

Raw animal foods (fish filet) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (vegetables) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Staff moved filet during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Units taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Eel was observed held at 76 degrees Fahrenheit in a toaster oven. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC elected to dispose. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of staff, recently prepared chicken was placed hot in the prep unit above the fill line. Staff removed overflow of chicken and placed in walk-in to rapidly chill; remainder of chicken was within proper temperature limits. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Working containers of various spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
Containers of oil and buckets of sauces were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen and walk-in. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

The containers of food/ingredients were observed in direct contact with the food below in the prep unit and in the walk-in. Containers were removed from the prep unit during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC brought to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of food and dry ingredients. A re-used can was used as a scoop in a container of rice. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. PIC removed bowls during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the following areas: -Bar (top of hand sink) -fry area (top shelving) -kitchen (on boxes). New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024

The cola refrigerator and rice hot holding located in the kitchen area was not in good repair, observed with tape. The doors to the dessert low-boy were observed mis-aligned. New Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2024
The support column in the kitchen area is in poor repair, observed with peeling paint. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
